title: 第24章火针
novel_title: 凡人修仙：从废器房杂役开始
content_zh:
天亮以后，陈青山先洗了把脸。

    水盆里浮着一层灰。

    他看了看自己袖口，又抓了点炉灰蹭上去。昨夜熬出来的烟味还在，眼底也有血丝，不用装就像一夜没睡。

    很好。

    像个倒霉炼铜的，不像刚破境的。

    他把《小离火锻器诀·上篇》和《三十六基础灵纹补注》贴身收好，外面仍旧套着破封皮。黑木贡献牌也揣进怀里，出门时还故意咳了两声。

    隔壁周小满探出半个脑袋。

    “你还活着？”

    “差点没了。”

    周小满捏着鼻子道：“昨晚那味儿，我还以为你把床烧了。”

    “床没烧，铜胚差点烧穿。”

    “那破铜胚跟你有仇。”周小满打了个哈欠，“你又去哪儿？”

    “藏书阁，找点控火的旧抄页。”

    周小满一听藏书阁，摆摆手：“去吧去吧，别再买狗都不看的东西了。”

    陈青山没接话。

    狗看不看不重要。

    鼎看就行。

    藏书阁外阁仍是那股旧纸味。瘦老头坐在柜台后头，算盘珠子拨得慢，一见陈青山进门，眼皮抬了抬。

    “又是你？”

    “前辈。”

    “残篇看懂了？”

    “没看懂。”陈青山老老实实道，“就是越看越觉得自己不会。”

    瘦老头乐了。

    “这话倒像人话。今日要什么？”

    陈青山把黑木牌放到柜台上。

    “低阶术法区，最便宜的抄页。火弹术、御器术、小盾诀这类，不要全本，只要入门残抄。”

    瘦老头拨了两下算盘。

    “完整火弹术一百贡献，你买不起。御器初解八十，你也买不起。小盾诀便宜些，六十，还是买不起。”

    “所以要残抄。”

    “啧。”瘦老头从柜台底下抽出一个木匣，“火弹术入门抄页三张，三贡献。御器初解残抄两页，四贡献。小盾诀旧注三页，三贡献。另有练习飞刀胚，刀尖钝了一角，两贡献一枚。”

    陈青山算了一下。

    十二贡献。

    他牌子里本来只剩十八。

    疼。

    但这钱不能省。

    他把东西一一收好，出门时瘦老头又提醒了一句：“残抄只能练个样子，真打起来别指望它救命。”

    陈青山低头道谢。

    他心里回了一句。

    样子够了。

    真救命的东西，不能写在纸上。

    回到丁七号，他照旧关门、插栓、压炉灰。确认屋外没人停步，这才把几张抄页摊开。

    火弹术的抄页很粗。

    上面只写了怎么聚火、怎么成团、怎么甩出去。按这法子，练气三四层弟子也能丢个拳头大的火团，威力一般，声势倒不小。

    陈青山不喜欢声势。

    动静越大，越容易被人看见。

    他把《小离火锻器诀》压在旁边，又翻开《三十六基础灵纹补注》里的聚火纹。

    三张抄页上的运气线，和聚火纹起笔处有几分相近，只是火弹术要把火聚成团，聚火纹却讲“收气于尖”。

    尖。

    陈青山伸出右手，掌心吐出一缕火线。

    火线很稳。

    他没有把火线卷成团，而是按聚火纹的起笔，把火力往前一压。火线前端细了些，又散开。

    第一次，灭了。
content_en:
After dawn, Chen Qingshan washed his face first.

    There was a layer of ash floating in the basin.

    He looked at his sleeves, grabbed some ashes and rubbed them on. The smell of cigarette smoke from last night is still there, and there are bloodshot eyes under my eyes, so I don't have to pretend that I haven't slept all night.

    very good.

    He looks like an unlucky copper smelter, not like someone who just broke through.

    He put "Xiao Li Fire Forging Technique, Part 1" and "Thirty-Six Basic Spirit Patterns Supplementary Notes" close to his body, still with the torn cover on them. Heimu's contribution card was also put into his arms, and he coughed twice on purpose when he went out.

    Next door, Zhou Xiaoman poked half of his head out.

    "Are you still alive?"

    "It's almost gone."

    Zhou Xiaoman pinched his nose and said, "The smell last night, I thought you burned the bed."

    "The bed was not burned, and the copper embryo was almost burned through."

    "That broken copper embryo has a grudge against you." Zhou Xiaoman yawned, "Where are you going?"

    "Library Pavilion, look for some old fire control pages."

    When Zhou Xiaoman heard about the library, he waved his hand: "Go, go, don't buy anything that even a dog can't read."

    Chen Qingshan did not answer.

    It doesn’t matter whether the dog sees it or not.

    Just look at it.

    The outer pavilion of the library still smells like old paper. The thin old man sat behind the counter, moving the beads on his abacus slowly. When he saw Chen Qingshan come in, he raised his eyelids.

    "Is it you again?"

    "Senior."

    "Do you understand the remaining part?"

    "I don't understand." Chen Qingshan said honestly, "The more I read, the more I feel like I don't know how to do it."

    The thin old man was happy.

    "These words sound like human words. What do you want today?"

    Chen Qingshan put the black wood sign on the counter.

    "In the low-level spell area, the cheapest way to copy pages is for the fire bullet spell, weapon control spell, and small shield technique. You don't need to copy the whole book, just the basic copy."

    The thin old man did some calculations.

    "You can't afford the complete Fire Bullet Technique with a contribution of 100. You can't afford it with the initial understanding of Royal Weapon at 80. The Small Shield Technique is cheaper, at 60, you still can't afford it."

    "So I have to copy it incompletely."

    "Tsk." The thin old man pulled out a wooden box from under the counter, "Three pages of introduction to fire bomb technique, three contributions. Two pages of initial explanation of royal weapon, four contributions. Three pages of old notes on Small Shield Technique, three contributions. There is also a practice flying knife embryo, the tip of the knife is blunt, two contributions."

    Chen Qingshan did the math.

    Twelve contributions.

    Originally there were only eighteen left in his list.

    pain.

    But this money cannot be saved.

    He put the things away one by one, and when he went out, the thin old man reminded him again: "Canzai can only practice, don't expect it to save your life in a real fight."

    Chen Qingshan lowered his head and thanked him.

    He replied in his mind.

    Looks enough.

    Really life-saving things cannot be written on paper.

    Returning to Ding No. 7, he closed the door, bolted the door, and pressed the ashes as usual. After confirming that no one was stopping outside the house, he spread out a few pages.

    The page copy for Fire Bomb is very thick.

    It only describes how to gather fire, how to form a ball, and how to throw it out. According to this method, a disciple at the third or fourth level of Qi training can throw a ball of fire as big as a fist, with average power and considerable momentum.

    Chen Qingshan doesn't like momentum.

    The louder the movement, the easier it is to be seen.

    He pressed the "Xiao Li Fire Forging Technique" next to him and opened the "Thirty-six Basic Spiritual Patterns Supplementary Notes" to the Fire Gathering Pattern.

    The luck lines on the three pages are somewhat similar to the starting point of the fire-gathering pattern. However, the fire bomb technique requires the fire to be gathered into a ball, while the fire-gathering pattern talks about "concentrating the energy at the tip."

    tip.

    Chen Qingshan stretched out his right hand and spit out a ray of fire from his palm.

    The line of fire is very stable.

    He didn't roll the fire wire into a ball, but pressed the starting point of the fire gathering pattern and pressed the fire power forward. The front end of the line of fire became thinner and then spread out.

    The first time, it was destroyed.
